{{Quote|Ready on Three! This is Slammer. Over.|Slammer checks in|audio=ThisIsSlammer-SOR.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
'''Slammer''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], was serving under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "[[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]]" in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Blue]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike force [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to eradicate a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] around the world. Led by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Blue Squadron was tasked with destroying the Confederacy [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ryloth)|flagship]]. However, as the squadron made its way towards the enemy flagship, the Republic fleet met heavy resistance from the Confederacy's [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]], forcing the strike forces' commanders&mdash;[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]&mdash;to order a retreat. Blue Squadron eventually returned to the Republic's [[Resolute/Legends|command ship]], but not before all but two of Blue Squadrons' ten [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]]&mdash;including Slammer.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Got two on my tail. I can't shake 'em!''"<br />"''I can't help you, Axe. I've got my own problem.|Axe and Slammer, moments before the latter's death|audio=AxeSlammer-SOR.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
[[File:Blue_Squadron_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Blue Squadron flys into battle.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="clone pilots" /> Slammer was the name taken by a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]]<ref name="sor" /> born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During his training as a clone pilot, Slammer learned how to operate a variety of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="clone pilots" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Slammer was serving in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "[[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]]" alongside squadmates [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]], [[Tucker/Legends|Tucker]], [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]], and squad leader [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]].<ref name="sor" />

In 22 BBY,<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] seized control of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] populace, placing a strong Confederate [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|blockade]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] around the planet. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], including Slammer and [[Blue]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Ryloth. The Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] was ordered to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|destroy]] the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], allowing Republic ground forces to land on Ryloth and liberate the planet. Blue Squadron was tasked with destroying Tuuk's [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ryloth)|command ship]], and was placed under the command of Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="sor" /> even though she had never led a fighter squadron into battle before.<ref name="TCWTVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

Upon arriving out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Ryloth, the Republic task force began to [[Space warfare/Legends|engage]] the Confederate blockade, while Tano, flying her [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Jedi starfighter]], and Blue Squadron, [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], launched from the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of Skywalker's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. As Slammer and the rest of Blue Squadron made their way toward the enemy fleet, they were attacked by a tier of Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. Despite taking several [[Death/Legends|casualties]], Blue Squadron pushed on, cutting a path through the incoming Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. However, as the squadron neared Tuuk's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], Confederate reinforcements arrived in the form of four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], outnumbering the Republic forces.<ref name="sor" />

With the Republic fleet taking heavy fire from the Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and droid starfighters, Yularen and Skywalker ordered a full retreat. The strike force commanders also told Tano to return to the ''Resolute'', but the stubborn Padawan disobeyed her superiors and continued with her assault.<ref name="sor" /> Slammer, under pressure from the enemy fighters, was unable to help Axe when his squad leader called on him for assistance and, as Blue Squadron began to take more casualties from enemy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire and Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Slammer was killed.
[[File:BlueSquadron.png|thumb|right|250px|Slammer, seconds before his starfighter explodes during the Battle of Ryloth.]]
Overwhelmed, Tano finally obeyed her orders and she herself ordered the remaining members of Blue Squadron to retreat to the Republic fleet. As they headed back towards the ''Resolute'', Blue Squadron was pursued by the Vulture droids, resulting in Axe too being shot down by the Vulture droids.<ref name="sor" /> Aside from Tano, the only survivors of the original ten clone pilots of Blue Squadron that managed to return to the ''Resolute'', which fled into hyperspace as soon as the remainders of the squadron boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], were [[Swoop (clone trooper)/Legends|Swoop]], and [[Kickback/Legends|Kickback]].<ref name="sor guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="tcwce">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Slammer was a clone pilot trained to handle a variety of starfighters for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="clone pilots" /> but he was not skilled enough to assist Axe when the squad leader asked Slammer for help during the battle over Ryloth. He wore [[white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[blue]] markings on his helmet.<ref name="sor" /> Like all clone troopers, Slammer stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="clone pilots" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slammer's first appearance was in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. "Storm over Ryloth" first aired on [[February 27]], [[2009]], and in the episode, Slammer is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices every clone trooper in the show.<ref name="sor guide" />
